name: capabilityBearer
native_effect: Bearer uniqueness is encoded as Mode→Organization 1; bearer-side Characterization would make every Organization capable and is deferred.
approved_decision: Keep EnterpriseCapability as a Mode dependent on exactly one Organization. Preserve the current Mode-to-bearer property and add a bearer-to-Mode Characterization only after confirming inverse semantics; do not require every Organization to have a capability.
negative_acceptance: One intrinsic Mode cannot inhere in two distinct Organizations.

name: capacityBearer
native_effect: Generic target remains untyped. Two routes and exactly-one-of-two cannot be represented by a naive pair of optional Characterizations; introduce scoped bearer types or explicit constraints after formal design review.
approved_decision: Use typed Organization and Facility bearer routes beneath a common query surface; each SupplyCapacity Mode has exactly one of these bearers. Keep SupplyCapacityObservationResult separate.
negative_acceptance: Do not infer capacity from an aggregate observation or assign the same intrinsic Mode to two different bearer individuals.

name: contextClassificationJurisdiction
native_effect: Legal-scope reference retained; no Mediation to rigid Jurisdiction.
approved_decision: Keep RegulatoryJurisdiction as a formal legal-scope reference of the contextual assignment. Do not type direct Relator-to-rigid-Kind Mediation; introduce a role only if dependence is evidenced.
negative_acceptance: Classification in J1 does not transfer to J2.

name: entryInScheme
native_effect: Typed scheme reference retained without global exact-one or code-string identity.
approved_decision: Retain a typed scheme-and-version reference. Do not merge equal lexical codes across schemes or impose an exactly-one-scheme axiom until the entry identity criterion is agreed.
negative_acceptance: Equal code strings across schemes do not identify one entry.

name: hasActiveSubstance
native_effect: Product-specific typed relation added; native/OWL subproperty link and source admission follow in G3-2e-F. Presentation-specific route remains source-gated.
approved_decision: Keep the broad parent property. Add a Product-specific child for evidenced M016 mappings and a Presentation-specific child only when a source explicitly supports it.
negative_acceptance: Do not infer that a presentation using the parent relation is a MedicinalProduct; these Kinds are disjoint.

name: hasDosageForm
native_effect: Specification reference retained without global min/max.
approved_decision: Keep a formal reference to DosageFormSpecification. Defer global minimum and maximum cardinalities until Presentation identity and source completeness are evaluated.
negative_acceptance: A generic Product dosage label does not identify this Presentation's form.

name: hasMatchConfidence
native_effect: Each Quality associated through this relation has one Assertion; zero or more Qualities per Assertion preserves unscored cases. Required Characterization and completeness are unresolved.
approved_decision: Treat MatchConfidence as a Quality dependent on one EntityMatchAssertion, but hold class-wide Characterization and the minimum-one constraint until unscored assertions are resolved. Record this as an open conformance blocker.
negative_acceptance: One Quality individual cannot belong to two distinct Assertions.

name: hasPackageConfiguration
native_effect: Configuration reference retained without mereology or universal existence.
approved_decision: Keep a reference to PackageConfiguration as a specification. Do not use componentOf or a universal existence constraint until identity and completeness are established.
negative_acceptance: A pack-size value is insufficient to identify a configuration.

name: presentationOf
native_effect: Formal association retained without universal OWL exact-one axiom.
approved_decision: Keep presentationOf as a formal Presentation-to-Product association. Examine the one-Product identity condition in the candidate, but defer a universal OWL cardinality until author review.
negative_acceptance: A Product source row alone does not instantiate a Presentation.

name: shortagePresentation
native_effect: Presentation scoped relation retained, evidence-gated at instance admission.
approved_decision: Create shortagePresentation only when a source identifies the exact Presentation, period and jurisdiction. Do not derive it from a Product-only report.
negative_acceptance: Product-only report does not identify a package/presentation.

name: shortageProduct
native_effect: Product scoped relation retained, no propagation to all presentations.
approved_decision: Record shortageProduct only with an identified Product and report scope; do not infer shortages for all of its Presentations.
negative_acceptance: Presentation shortage does not establish shortage of all presentations.

name: withinCountry
native_effect: Versioned containment reference retained; self-containment and completeness constraints deferred to SHACL.
approved_decision: Keep withinCountry as a versioned formal spatial or administrative reference; prohibit self-containment and limit an exactly-one-Country constraint to proven data scope.
negative_acceptance: Country cannot be within itself; Jurisdiction is distinct.

name: withinRegion
native_effect: Versioned administrative/spatial reference retained; postal inference and self-containment deferred to SHACL.
approved_decision: Keep a versioned formal administrative or spatial reference; reject self-containment and postal-label inference, and scope any exactly-one-Region rule to complete sources.
negative_acceptance: Region cannot be within itself or inferred from postal label.
